relevance.why: Token limits on Claude Max are a real constraint for a solo builder; a free multi-provider router is relevant, but routing coding work off Claude to random free-tier models degrades quality and adds a new dependency.

implement_score.why: Cheap to try (one install), but stitching 90+ free tiers together is fragile, introduces data-handling and ToS risk, and for Claude Code the value of consistent model quality outweighs 'free tokens'. Possibly useful for non-critical batch/side tasks only.

verify: Does github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute exist with ~54k stars, and is it actively maintained?
Does the '1.51B free tokens/month' figure assume signing up for dozens of provider free tiers (and does that violate provider ToS)?
Can it actually sit in front of Claude Code (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL compatible) or only in front of chat clients?
Where do prompts/data go when routed through third-party free providers?
